verdicts.reason: A shrinks the Quillbrook roundel logo to a tiny bullet beside the kicker, which damages the brand. Its product bag is small, pushed into the bottom-left corner and nearly touching the edge, the peach circle sits behind the headline, and the legal line is too small to read. B keeps the logo, the bag-in-circle motif and the reading order, but the logo crowds the headline with mismatched left edges, the headline is undersized and the CTA is small and close to the bottom edge. B's legal line also floats alone at the lower right with dead space beneath the circle.
